body.x: If you’ve been having trouble deciding what gift to buy your parents, your worries are over. Panasonic has just released a product that is just what you’ve been looking for.

Panasonic will be displaying the EP-MA70 high-quality massage chair in its booth at the electronics show. Packing a 3D massage mechanism, the EP-MA70 can be controlled with the dexterity of the human hand. The chair is able to change the massage movement to match the areas that are sore, and you can also have a full body massage from your shoulders all the way to your feet. Employing the 2WAY method, it can be used as a regular easy chair when you don’t need a massage.

Another product that will be displayed is the riding fitness machine JOBA EU7805, which is based on a scientific analysis of horseback riding. The product reproduces the movement of a horse through five-axis “new figure-eight motion.” Users of the JOBA EU78025 can select from seven kinds of exercise benefits altogether, ranging from maintaining walking ability for the elderly to increasing driving distance for golfers. The addition of twist and up-and-down motions exercises your body from the waist to the thigh.
(Photo: visitors are experiencing JOBA EU7805, based on a scientific analysis of horseback riding )

In other news, Panasonic will also be unveiling its smart monitoring service Security Pana. The Security Pana is a service that allows users to monitor a desired location in real time on their smartphone or tablet computer. After setting up a Panasonic network camera in a place of your choice, register with the Security Pana service. Now, using the Security Pana applications that you have installed on your smart device, you can watch the spot whenever you want. This is a useful service for parents who work outside of the home, kindergarten teachers who want to help nervous parents relax, and many others.
